releases.name: Missed Class: Horror
releases.summary:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

releases.summary: * The Question Game!* Currently for free!* Have fun and get to know your fellow players by asking daring questions!A Question Game is an awesome game where you get to know your family, friends, lover or party crowd. Find out about their biggest dreams, craziest adventures or intimate secrets. Add great question list for different occasions, like party guests or flirting.Features:* Ask your favorite questions on facebook or twitter* Mail or message questions to friends* Save favourite questions for the next game

releases.name: Wrenny Lee: Witch-for-Hire!
releases.summary: A short visual novel comedy about Wrenny, a hard-working witch! The freelance life is anything but magical!

releases.name: Trap Yuri Tempest
releases.summary: A romantic storm is brewing at Ayanohara Academy! At an elite cross-dressing all-boys school, a scheme to stop heartbroken "he-iresses" leads to the uncovering of an old friend's royal secret, new foes, and new romances in this hilarious and sultry next chapter in this unique visual novel series!

releases.summary: THREE Amazing Hidden Object Games onboard theLuxury USS Liberty of the Waves. 1.The Americas 2.Round the World 3.The Atlantic & Pacific

releases.name: SweatyPanzer
releases.summary: Round-based 4v4 tank combat where armour is a decision. Angle your plates, bounce shells, hunt weak zones, and spend salvage between rounds. One life a round, first to four takes the match. Free to play.

releases.name: Kibo to Yume
releases.summary: A revolutionary RPG with a mind-blowing plot, a humorous touch and..... a soundtrack so good, you can't focus on playing the game...

releases.name: Scratch Tickets With Your Friends
releases.summary: Raise your monster to be the best. Train them to improve strength, speed and accuracy to battle in arenas. In arenas you capture monsters to breed new, stronger monsters to advance through all the arenas. The unique lifespan only allows you to have each monster for a maximum of 4 days. In this time you raise it as best you can and battle as far as you can before you breed it to make a strong baby to go further then the parents.Follow me at http:www.facebook.com/monstergenerations

releases.name: Core Idle TD
releases.summary: A unique and challenging puzzle game where you must match and collect nuts and berries to win!

releases.name: Puzzle Arcade Pals
releases.summary: A wholesome, ad-free puzzle collection designed specifically for kids. Featuring Spot the Difference, Jigsaw Puzzles, and classic Brick Breaker with charming themes, zero microtransactions, and simple, screen-safe gameplay.

releases.name: Las 5 Celdas
releases.summary: Las 5 Celdas is a short first-person psychological horror experience. Explore five impossible cells, each based on a different human fear, and face disturbing situations where there may be no perfect answer.

releases.name: Mortality... Please
releases.summary: Any warehouse manager would kill for a heavy-duty hero like this to move the goods. So many crates to stack, so little time. But when you happen to have a forklift with a magnetic arm, moving boxes goes a lot faster. Unfortunately, warehouses of the future can be tricky to navigate. Solve this puzzle game's secrets to load up the truck on each level. Forklifts are easy to operate...right? The packages are ready to be loaded onto the truck°™all you have to do is get them there. Move your loader, pick up the boxes, and stack them on the truck to succeed in this puzzle game. It°Øs not as easy as it sounds°™solve sequence codes, avoid obstacles and treat delicate packages carefully! Complete each taxing task to become the ultimate loader. The madcap machine is back with many more physics puzzles to solve. These trucks ain°Øt gonna load themselves! Break out a can of elbow grease and start moving the crates.

releases.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2026
releases.summary: "You, Me and Words" is an addictive and fun word puzzle game. If you are a fan of games like Boggle and Scrabble, you will love the unique challenge of "You, Me and Words". Train your brain, build your vocabulary and show your friends who is the real vocabulist.Features:- Unlimited puzzles: each puzzle is unique- Three game levels- Word lists from popular categories- Word lists with foreign words- Auto save game state on exit- Local scoreboard- Email to friendsWord Lists:- Basic, standard English words- SAT vocabulary, GRE vocabulary- Animals- Food & Drink- Fruit & Vegetable- Family- Boy names- Girl names- Body parts- Colors- Sports- Music & Instruments- Transport- Weapons- Weather- World countries- German words- French words- Spanish words- Italian words

releases.name: Highscore
releases.summary: Welcome to the world of Words of 5 HDThis game will challenge everything you think you know about 5 letter words. Rearrange each of the 5 letters in front of you to create a word. But you must do this within a certain time limit. Over 6,000 words to keep you on your toes. 2 Game modes -InfinityYou have 20 seconds to unscramble each word. -StrikeYou have 3 minutes to unscramble as many words as you can. Fan of the game? Like us on Facebook Words of 5

releases.name: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: How many bottles can you open within 10 seconds?“Bottle opening -- the fight of the century!!! A matter of one second!!”.................................................................................- Simple manipulation    This game requires only one means of control,i.e., touch and slide. You need to employ a precise, quick technique of touch and slide  that will make you a champion in bottle opening.     The rules are simple: Join as if you are participating in an actual “master bottle opening championship competition”   in a real arena.  After the start signal, using your finger as opener, perform precise, quick touch and slide up to open as many bottles as possible within 10 seconds. Pong! Pong! Pong! Those bottle lids will fly away along with a light, swift, jingling sound. Here, what matters is that you select only the bottles labeled with the same Pilo character as that on the left of the screen. Once all of the bottles on the screen are opened, touch and slide with your finger from left to right on the screen to bring in a new set of bottles.  .................................................................................- Game mode - Multiple players: You can compete with other players in bottle opening via the game center. -3. Level-up system    The coins you obtained can be used to purchase other higher-level bottle openers.   Level-up 1 (1,000 coins) Bronze opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening two bottles.    Level-up 2 (5,000 coins) Silver opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening three.    Level-up 3 (10,000 coins) Gold opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening four.    Level-up 4 (50,000 coins) Master opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening five. ................................................................................- Universal App: This App is a universal app that you can use on both iPhones and iPads with one-time purchase.................................................................................-5. releases.name: Tab-lings
releases.summary: A simple, amazingly addictive, game for word lovers! *There's a word you have to guess. There are 4 coins that contain hints. These word hints are related in some way. Use the hints to guess the word and earn more coins!Stumped on a word? Spend some coins to use helpers. They can reveal a letter in the word, show the definition of the word, or when really stumped, reveal the word.If you love word games, you will find HeyWords quick to learn and a lot of fun!What are you waiting for…get your WORD on!

releases.name: Immortal Chess
releases.summary: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

releases.name: Smoke Keeper
releases.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

releases.name: Knode: Untangle & Connect
releases.summary: Untangle knots and connect cables on a mysterious concrete platform in the middle of the ocean. But you’re not alone. The AI running the testing program seems to want to be your friend..

releases.name: Raw Egg Peeling
releases.summary: A relaxing game about peeling an egg.

releases.name: From Unknown to Legendary Idol
releases.summary: As the manager of a wildly popular idol group, support a young girl auditioning to become its newest member. The audition’s challenge is an unexpected series of puzzles! Solve clever riddles and hidden mechanisms to guide her on the path to becoming a legendary idol.

releases.name: The Crooked Hand
releases.summary: Collaborate to make music for the next episode of Hook Ups.  Lay down an instrument and send your track to a collaborator to add another. Four instruments can be added to each track before it is submitted to the Hook Ups team. ***Share your tracks on SoundCloud and Facebook. ***New instruments loaded periodically. ***Watch the cartoons at http://www.facebook.com/hookupstv
